policy: Each decision is open until its closing lot records the decision, rationale and executable evidence. No decision here is a support claim.
An unsupported source format or browser target must be recorded before a project that needs it is accepted; it cannot silently leave a profile.
Evidence references identify inspected source (evidence class E1) unless stated otherwise.

decisions.question: Which JavaScript/TypeScript module extensions are accepted source formats, and do all hosts agree?
decisions.alpha1: Project session SOURCE_RE accepts .js/.jsx/.ts/.tsx/.mjs/.cjs; the Rsbuild adapter accepts .js/.mjs/.cjs/.jsx/.ts/.tsx; the Next adapter rule tests /\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/ and therefore also matches .mts/.cts/.mjsx/.cjsx. The host filters disagree on .mts/.cts.
upstreamEvidence: StyleX 0.19.1 unplugin core.js JS_LIKE_RE /\.[cm]?[jt]sx?(\?|$)/
Panda 2.2.0 pandacss_sfc js.rs

decisions.question: Is Vue single-file-component source accepted, with a dedicated source identity adapter, or recorded as unsupported?
decisions.alpha1: The Vite adapter throws UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE for .vue modules: SFC submodules need a dedicated source identity adapter.
upstreamEvidence: Panda 2.2.0 extracts Vue SFC templates and scripts (crates/pandacss_sfc/src/vue.rs)
StyleX 0.19.1 unplugin transforms JS-like and Svelte ids only

decisions.question: Is Svelte component source accepted?
upstreamEvidence: Panda 2.2.0 crates/pandacss_sfc/src/svelte.rs
